subject: Long-tail trace storage: credit structure + premium dashboard seat pricing
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@logimed.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@logimed.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on long-tail trace retention billing + dashboard seats

Mateo —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We made good progress; two items came up during our internal sizing/finance review and procurement wanted me to confirm before we move to a signed SOW:

1) Long‑tail traces (events older than 90 days): your team mentioned a "long‑tail storage" approach that is cheaper than hot retention but still searchable. How is that billed? Is it metered by GB-month or a slab/credit model? Can we get an indicative rate for ~3TB cold retention (monthly average) with 18 months of retention?

2) Advanced dashboards / premium visualizations: we expect 10–15 power users initially but procurement is asking whether you can give a discounted first‑year price for seats during the pilot; they also asked whether seats are monthly or annual.

Attached is a short spec of our retention profile and expected ingestion profile. Our procurement lead (procurement@logimed.com) is copied — they will own contract language and timing.

Goal: finalize pricing and get a redline to procurement by 11/23 so we can align budget.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Director, Platform Ops
LogiMed

Attachment: LogiMed_Retention_Specs.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@logimed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on long-tail trace retention billing + dashboard seats

Hi Samira —

Appreciate the clear ask and the spec — helpful. High level answers and three pricing approaches so procurement has options depending on risk tolerance and cash flow: 

Option 1 — Metered (no commit):
- Long‑tail traces billed at $0.045 / GB‑month (cold tier).
- In your 3TB example: ~3,000 GB * $0.045 = $135 / month (cold storage only).
- Dashboard seats: $40 / seat / month, billed monthly.
- Good if you want flexibility; no upfront credits.

Option 2 — Slab + consumption credits (recommended for pilot):
- Commit to a 12‑month slab for inferred cold storage credits (e.g., pre‑pay 24TB‑months of cold credits for a fixed monthly fee). Excess metered at lower metered rate $0.030 / GB‑month.
- For your profile (avg 3TB): we'd price the 12‑month slab at a monthly equivalent that yields a ~20% savings vs pure metered.
- Dashboards: offer a 1‑year pilot price of $25 / seat / month for up to 15 seats (first 12 months). After pilot revert to list.

Option 3 — Enterprise floor (multi‑year):
- 24‑month commit, includes long‑tail credits and 24/7 support SLA; deep discounts on dashboards (up to 35% off list) and a first‑year onboarding credit.

Concessions we can consider for LogiMed to get this across the line quickly:
- One‑time long‑tail storage credit covering 50% of cold storage spend for the first 6 months (applied as monthly credit).
- Dashboard pilot discount (Option 2) for up to 15 seats, then contractually cap increases to 10% / year thereafter.

I attached a draft offer (redwood_offer_v3.pdf) with the three options and line items. Jordan / Mina — can you please review the suggested concession levels above and confirm we can approve a 50% 6‑month credit and the $25 pilot seat price? Lauren — please flag any compliance/contract issues with the pilot seat cap (contractual cap on price growth).

If that works, Samira, I can send a cleaned offer and DocuSign link for procurement to review by 11/22.

Best,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_offer_v3.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on long-tail trace retention billing + dashboard seats

Mateo — quick internal note (quoting your message below).

We should be comfortable approving the 50% long‑tail credit for the first 6 months as a standard pilot concession — it's within our playbook for deals of this size and should remove price friction. The $25/seat pilot price for up to 15 seats also seems reasonable if we gate it to the 12‑month pilot and require a committed annual renewal at a minimum at month 13 or a conversion to per‑seat list.

A few negotiating points / asks:
- Ask finance to accept the slab prepay language but ensure there is a clear overage mechanism (excess at $0.030 / GB‑month).
- Keep the pilot seat cap explicit in the SOW (15 seats) and include a one‑time addendum to convert seats after pilot with 30 days notice.

Mina — are you okay to run a short technical demo next week to show how archived traces surface in the dashboard? If so we can keep the pilot timeline tight and include a field trial success metric in the SOW (e.g., query latency <= 2s on cold queries for 95th pct).

Lauren — please confirm no legal red flags on the seat cap + conversion language; if OK I'll proceed to finalize the offer.

— Jordan

Samira / procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal alignment (Jordan / Mina / Lauren), please see the concessioned commercial path we can put on the table to move forward: 

What we commit now:
- Long‑tail storage credit: Redwood will apply a 50% credit to your cold storage charges for months 1–6 (applied monthly against metered cold usage). After month 6, usage will be billed per the chosen model (slab or metered) at the rates outlined below.
- Dashboard pilot seats: $25 per seat per month for up to 15 seats, for months 1–12. Seats billed monthly.
- Overages / conversion: Any cold usage above pre‑paid slab (if you choose slab) billed at $0.030 / GB‑month. After month 12, seat price reverts to contracted list unless a renewal deal is signed.

Optional commitment structure we recommend (to lock in price and simplify billing):
- 12‑month slab prepay (equivalent to 24 TB‑months of cold credits) at a monthly rate that yields ~20% savings vs pure metered for your profile. If you sign the slab, the 50% 6‑month credit will be converted into a first‑month additional credit (to keep math simple) — we can show both views in the SOW.

Next steps:
1) I attached the final offer (redwood_offer_final.pdf) and copied a Drive folder with the pricing workbook.
2) Sign the DocuSign link below (this will create an initial SOW with pilot terms and seat cap).
3) Mina will run the cold‑trace demo on 11/30 (requested) and we will capture the trial success metric in the SOW.
